title: qa(checklist): `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json` enumerates 19 `os migrate` subcommands; `audit-key-material` (#26772) makes 20, so the item's --json sweep no longer covers the family
body:
Filing gate: **② a defect in a governed artefact, found at review** — the os-dev report on #26687 (out_of_scope_findings) and confirmed by the PM seat on `main`.
Business reason: the item `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json` (rev 7, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`) is the one clause that sweeps every `os migrate` subcommand for the #4873 `--json` exit contract. Its `variants` list and its `source` note ("the 19 registered subcommands") predate #26772, which added `os migrate audit-key-material`. A checklist run driving the item as written skips the new command, and neither `check-platform-checklist.mjs` nor its watchdog reads the count.
Reader: the `checklist-author` seat (the platform checklist ledger).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "checklist cli.migrate-plan-apply-json variants os migrate subcommand count" — 26 hits, none about this item's enumeration.

## Evidence (on `main` at `a5df0942e1`)

- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/` holds 20 registered subcommands; the item lists 19 as variants and its source says 19.
- `os migrate audit-key-material` takes the same flags as `audit-mail-bodies` (`--apply`, `--yes`, `--force`, `--json`), so it belongs in the sweep.

## Done when

- The item's `variants` list carries `audit-key-material`, its source note states the current count (or stops stating a count), and its `revision` is bumped with a history line citing #26772.
- Optional, the author's call: a check that compares the variants list with the registered subcommand directory, so the next addition reds instead of drifting silently.
